provenance: Application-owned synthetic feed. Opta-inspired (F24-style) structure, not a licensed Opta wire schema. These definitions describe normalized records after the adapter.

fields.event_id: Stable identity of one recorded action, including later corrections.
fields.match_id: Identity of the match containing the action.
fields.revision: Increasing correction version for the same event identity; not another action.
fields.event_type: Category of the recorded action. A category and a body-part qualifier are independent dimensions.
fields.team_id: Team credited with this recorded action, not necessarily the team benefiting from its outcome.
fields.player_id: Actor credited with this record. For a shot, the shooter; for a save, the goalkeeper; for a pass, the passer. Never the implicit opponent or receiver.
fields.body_part: Contact method of this action. Headed actions can belong to many event categories; this is not a header-only event category. Missing means unknown, not foot.
fields.period: Football period: 1 first half, 2 second half, 3/4 extra-time halves, 5 shootout. Stoppage time remains in its period.
fields.match_time_seconds: Broadcast football clock in seconds (timeMin*60 + timeSec), not wall-clock or seconds since the current half began. The second half starts at 2700. First-half stoppage keeps period 1 with values above 2700, and second-half stoppage can exceed 5400, so clock ranges overlap across periods: order by period then clock, or by sequence.
fields.outcome: Result or subtype of this action: success/failure for completion or duels; off_target/post/saved/blocked for unsuccessful shots; yellow/second_yellow/red for cards. A saved shot is attributed to its shooter, not the saving goalkeeper. Missing is unknown.
fields.distance_metres: Recorded ball travel distance of this pass or clearance, including unsuccessful passes when supplied. Not distance run by its player. Missing is not evidence of zero distance.
fields.deleted: Correction withdrawing this event; it no longer contributes to current totals.
fields.sequence: Delivery order within the recording; the authoritative event order when clock values repeat. Missing in older records.
fields.video_seconds: Real-time capture/video offset in seconds. Never decreases with sequence. It is not the football clock.
fields.x: Opta 0-100 length coordinate of the action for the acting team: its attack runs towards x=100. Opposite teams use mirrored frames. Null when the record has no team or location.
fields.y: Opta 0-100 width coordinate for the acting team: y=0 is its right touchline. Null when the record has no team or location.
fields.possession_id: Possession sequence number. Increases when the other team gains the ball or a restart is taken. Null for administrative records.
fields.qualifiers: Named provider qualifiers kept for context, e.g. endX/endY/angle/longBall/cross/chipped/switchOfPlay/offsidePass on passes; situation/assistEventId/bigChance/goalMouthY/goalMouthZ/shotOutcome on attempts; saveType/defensiveBlock/fromShotOffTarget on saves; penaltyAwarded on fouls; cardReason on cards; leadsTo on errors; relatedEventId for paired records. Coordinates use the acting team's frame. Missing keys are unknown.

events.pass: Ball distribution by the passer. Count measures number of actions; sum of distance_metres measures ball travel. Completion is outcome success/failure. These are distinct measures, neither is implied by the topic passing alone.
events.shot: Unsuccessful attempt at goal by the shooter; outcome off_target, post, saved or blocked when recorded. Saved shots retain the shooter as player_id. Goalkeeper actions are separate save records.
events.goal: Successful scoring attempt by the scorer, stored separately from shot. All shooting attempts span shot and goal; a scored attempt is not also a shot record in this feed. It keeps the attempt's location and qualifiers. Own-goal attribution is not modeled.
events.corner: Corner taken by the recorded player/team when the recording lists taken restarts. The award is a separate corner_awarded record.
events.card: Disciplinary card shown to its recipient; outcome records its colour.
events.save: Goalkeeper save (qualifier saveType caught/parried) or outfield block (defensiveBlock), credited to the defending player. Counting these records for an attacking player does not measure that player's shots being saved.
events.tackle: Tackle on a ball owner by the tackler; outcome success when the tackler's team gains the ball or play stops. The ball owner has a paired dispossessed record on success.
events.clearance: Target-less defensive ball away from the clearing team's own goal area; distance_metres is ball travel when supplied.
events.interception: Opponent's first intentional contact on a moving pass away from the passer, credited to the intercepting player. Close blocks are blocked_pass instead.
events.foul: Foul committed by the recorded player/team. Does not identify the player fouled.
events.touch: Explicit standalone touch record. It is not an umbrella record for every pass, shot or other ball contact.
events.throw_in: Throw-in actually taken by the recorded player/team. Its distribution may also have a pass record; these are not two passes.
events.free_kick: Free kick actually taken. A restart record alone is not a pass, shot or foul; the corresponding action and offence are separate records.
events.goal_kick: Goal kick actually taken by the recorded player/team. A related pass record describes the distribution.
events.kick_off: Kick-off restart executed by the recorded team. It is not a goal or pass count by itself.
events.penalty: Penalty kick actually taken; the attempt is recorded separately as shot or goal. This is not a penalty award or a shootout result.
events.offside: Referee offside decision attributed to the offending player/team. Offside is not a foul.
events.foul_won: Whistled foul attributed to its victim and benefiting team. The offender has a separate foul record; adding these doubles the incident count.
events.keeper_claim: Goalkeeper retaining a ball above 1.2 m without a confirmed linked shot. Do not count these as saves.
events.period_start: Match period begins. Administrative record; player and team may be unknown.
events.period_end: Match period ends. Administrative record; player and team may be unknown.
events.dispossessed: Ball owner losing the ball to a successful tackle. Credited to the player who lost it.
events.blocked_pass: Opponent's contact on a pass close to the passer; credited to the blocking player.
events.aerial: Aerial duel. One record per contested player: outcome success for the winner and failure for the loser, so a duel has two records.
events.take_on: Ball owner beating a goal-side opponent; outcome success when they get past.
events.challenge: Defender beaten by a take_on; credited to the defender, not a tackle.
events.ball_recovery: Gaining a loose or dying ball, confirmed by the same team's next contact.
events.out: Ball over a touchline or goal line. The team that put it out has outcome failure and its player; the other team has a paired success record. Adding both double-counts the incident.
events.corner_awarded: Corner decision. Outcome success for the team awarded the corner and failure for the conceding team. Not the taken corner.
events.keeper_pickup: Goalkeeper picking up a lower ball. Not a save.
events.punch: Goalkeeper deflecting a high ball without keeping it.
events.offside_provoked: The deepest outfield defender who provoked an offside decision; paired with the offside record.
events.error: Defensive-third turnover followed within 6 s by an opponent attempt; qualifier leadsTo is shot or goal.
events.ball_touch: Accidental contact by the team in possession that gives the ball to the opponent.

guarantees: One latest non-deleted revision contributes per event_id; duplicate delivery does not mean another action.
A shot record and a save record may describe opposite participants in one football incident. They are not interchangeable actors, and summing them double-counts that incident.
Paired records (aerial, out, corner_awarded, tackle/dispossessed, take_on/challenge, offside/offside_provoked, foul/foul_won) describe one incident from each side; count one side for incident totals.
Whole-match scope has no period restriction. Clock bounds do not imply a half; half selection includes its stoppage time. Clock values overlap across periods.
Player and team restrictions are separate. A player's known club is not an implicit requested team filter.
Events are timestamped when they resolve; observed history never includes later outcomes.

Custom calculations filter only event_type, team_id, player_id, body_part, period, match_time_seconds and outcome, and sum only distance_metres. Coordinates, possession_id, video_seconds and qualifiers are context for answers, not filterable fields.
unavailable: Player running distance, speed, xG, opponent/recipient identity, substitutions, injuries, VAR and own-goal classification.
Location (zone, penalty area, final third), possession-sequence and qualifier filters in custom calculations; the values exist but the calculation contract cannot select them yet.
Corner-taker identity, own-goal classification, shot-on-target last-line-block classification and richer provider qualifiers.
This describes data availability only. Allowed calculation operators and output fields are defined by the supplied decision schema and compiler, not by football knowledge.
